"""Inspect composed numerical optimizations on exact integrated main."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import contextlib
import cProfile
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import pstats
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import tracemalloc
from collections.abc import Iterator
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path.cwd()
HARNESS = Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121')
BASE = '11745ab11070765974b90f5a8f512bf4c30576b1'
SOURCE_PATH = 'flagquantum/compiler/optimization/one_qubit_optimization.py'
OUTPUT = Path('/private/tmp/fq-integrated-numerical-controls-20261122.json')

def git(folder: Path, *arguments: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *arguments], cwd=folder, text=True, timeout=15).strip()

assert git(HARNESS, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == '9aa9260920984e2ca05bcb293abb885fccd9c144'
assert not git(HARNESS, 'status', '--porcelain')
sys.path.insert(0, str(HARNESS / 'src'))
from flagquantum.compiler.optimization import one_qubit_optimization as one_qubit
from flagquantum.compiler.optimization import two_qubit_optimization as two_qubit
from flagquantum.compiler import optimize
from flagquantum.core.ir import CircuitIR, Instruction
from sdkbench.candidates.adapters import load_adapter, workflow_configuration
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing

replacements = []
source_records = []
for module, function_name, path in (
    (one_qubit, 'collapse_one_qubit_runs', SOURCE_PATH),
    (two_qubit, '_matmul', 'flagquantum/compiler/optimization/two_qubit_optimization.py'),
):
    candidate_function = getattr(module, function_name)
    old_source = git(ROOT, 'show', BASE + ':' + path)
    node = next(item for item in ast.parse(old_source).body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == function_name)
    namespace = dict(vars(module))
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), BASE + ':' + path, 'exec'), namespace)
    replacements.append((candidate_function, namespace[function_name]))
    source_records.append({'path': path, 'candidate_sha256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'baseline_sha256': hashlib.sha256(old_source.encode()).hexdigest()})

@contextlib.contextmanager
def variant(name: str) -> Iterator[None]:
    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
        if name == 'baseline':
            for module_name, module in tuple(sys.modules.items()):
                if module_name.startswith('flagquantum.') and module is not None:
                    for key, value in tuple(vars(module).items()):
                        for candidate_function, baseline_function in replacements:
                            if value is candidate_function:
                                stack.enter_context(patch.object(module, key, baseline_function))
        yield

def observe(case: tuple[int, str, str], workflow: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    width, family, topology = case
    bundle = Bundle(HARNESS / 'docs/implementation')
    acceptance = bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width == 8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}']
    config = workflow_configuration(workflow)
    adapter = load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={'options': {'sdk': config['sdk'], 'workflow': workflow, 'compiler_options': config}}))
    source = fixture(width, family, topology, '01' * 32)
    seed = bundle.plan['execution_profile']['compiler_seeds'][0]
    start = time.perf_counter()
    payload = adapter.execute('route', source, seed)
    seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
    metrics = routing(payload, source, None, acceptance, 0)
    assert payload['final_layout'] == list(range(width))
    normalized = json.dumps({key: payload[key] for key in ('operations', 'final_layout')}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)
    return {'metrics': metrics, 'normalized_output_sha256': hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode()).hexdigest(), 'audit': dict(adapter.audit), 'seconds': seconds}

report: dict[str, Any] = {'implementation_commit': git(ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'base_commit': BASE, 'source_commit': git(HARNESS, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'scope': 'Inspected single-device shared macOS development controls, one numerical thread; no qualified timing, process RSS, prospective, SDK ranking or scalability claim', 'source_files': source_records, 'baseline_scope': 'Only the two specified functions are restored from base_commit; all other code is implementation_commit. This is an isolated composition control, not a checkout-to-checkout comparison.', 'driver': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'complete': False, 'rows': [], 'timing': [], 'memory': [], 'profiles': []}

def checkpoint() -> None:
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')

for workflow in ('flagquantum-ordinary-restored', 'flagquantum-target-artifact'):
    for index, case in enumerate(itertools.product((6, 8, 12), ('qaoa', 'ising', 'hopping', 'qft', 'repetition'), ('line', 'ring', 'grid', 'sparse'))):
        observations = {}
        for mode in (('baseline', 'candidate') if index % 2 == 0 else ('candidate', 'baseline')):
            with variant(mode):
                observations[mode] = observe(case, workflow)
        assert all(observations['baseline'][key] == observations['candidate'][key] for key in ('metrics', 'normalized_output_sha256', 'audit')), (workflow, case, observations)
        report['rows'].append({'workflow': workflow, 'case': case, 'observations': observations})
        checkpoint()
    print('Accepted all 60 paired workflows:', workflow, flush=True)

for case in ((6, 'qft', 'grid'), (6, 'repetition', 'ring'), (12, 'qft', 'grid')):
    samples = {'baseline': [], 'candidate': []}
    for iteration in range(11):
        for mode in (('baseline', 'candidate') if iteration % 2 == 0 else ('candidate', 'baseline')):
            with variant(mode):
                observed = observe(case, 'flagquantum-target-artifact')
            if iteration >= 2:
                samples[mode].append(observed['seconds'])
    report['timing'].append({'case': case, 'workflow': 'flagquantum-target-artifact', 'warmups_per_variant': 2, 'samples_seconds': samples, 'median_seconds': {mode: statistics.median(values) for mode, values in samples.items()}})
    for mode in ('baseline', 'candidate'):
        with variant(mode):
            tracemalloc.start()
            observed = observe(case, 'flagquantum-target-artifact')
            peak = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()[1]
            tracemalloc.stop()
        report['memory'].append({'case': case, 'mode': mode, 'python_peak_bytes': peak, 'scope': 'Fixture, adapter, compilation and independent acceptance; Python traced allocations, not process RSS'})
    checkpoint()
    print(case, report['timing'][-1]['median_seconds'], flush=True)
report['complete'] = True
checkpoint()
